user_query: gmail and trass.tg discord entries in any workspace about a flights airlines

intent.goal: find entries about flights/airlines in gmail and discord channels

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.message_content, '') as message_content
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'tg')
AND (
    g.subject LIKE '%flight%' OR g.subject LIKE '%airline%'
    OR g.message_content LIKE '%flight%' OR g.message_content LIKE '%airline%'
    OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%flight%' OR g.body_snippet LIKE '%airline%'
    OR u.title LIKE '%flight%' OR u.title LIKE '%airline%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
